why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against its expect line. Checks 3 and 4 hold: "documents" fairly implies saying what the flag does, and "after merge" justifies requiring the PR to be merged and the live page to be fetched. Check 1 goes beyond its words. PASS requires "each `--shout` run exits 0", and FAIL includes "a `--shout` run exits non-zero". "prints the greeting in upper case" says nothing about exit codes. Check 2 also goes beyond its words. Its expect line is about output, but PASS requires "stdout, stderr and the exit code are identical", and it adds the no-name usage case. An exit code is not output, so this is stricter than "the output is unchanged". These exit-code tests should be under Advisory, not in the PASS/FAIL conditions.
